data.rationale: The proposal only captures one piece of the multi-city flight search: it covers entering the first segment's From/To/Depart but leaves out navigating to Plan Travel > Flights, the other segments, Add another flight, Search and sort, it hardcodes the JFK/LHR airport picks, and it names no parameters, so it couldn't be turned into an automation as written.
